source: Jane (default speaker), published TEXTBOOK word_clips, measured contours, pulled 28 Sep 2026 with: select w.id, w.tones, c.onset_s, c.duration_s, c.contour from words w join word_clips c on c.word_id = w.id join speakers s on s.id = c.speaker_id where s.is_default and c.style = 'textbook' and c.status = 'published'. Every 4th single-syllable word per tone by id, and the first 3 two-syllable words (by id) per non-neutral combo. contour = [[t, chao]] with t a 0..1 fraction of the tone window (durationS long); voiced frames only.
